sector_news.headline: Dwarka E-way area sees 135% rise in home prices in 5 years: Report
sector_news.figure: Anarock data: Dwarka Expressway avg residential price rose from Rs 6,032/sq ft (2021) to Rs 14,180/sq ft (H1 2026), vs Gurugram's overall average of Rs 13,350/sq ft

sector_news.headline: Dwarka Expressway challenges Gurugram's old luxury addresses after 135% price surge
sector_news.figure: ANAROCK estimates average residential prices in the Dwarka Expressway micro-market at around Rs 21,700-24,000 per sq ft, after a 135% rise over 5 years; homes above Rs 2.5 Cr now the dominant budget segment

sector_news.headline: SPR, Sohna emerge as South Gurugram's next real estate growth engines as prices surge
sector_news.figure: Magicbricks data: SPR average residential prices reached ~Rs 16,249/sq ft, up 18.4% YoY in 2026 (up from ~Rs 9,800/sq ft five years ago, a 165% five-year rise)

sector_news.headline: 'Gurugram property jumps Rs 1.4 crore if you blink': Real estate advisor drops hard truth
